---
title: "Job List"
---
  
## Clear

Deletes all jobs from the database. <br>
That clears also mcp's database. <br>

## Delete

Deletes a specific job from the database. <br>
That also deletes the job from mcp's database. <br>

## Save to JobList

Takes all jobs and saves them to a new joblist file in the subdirectory `joblists`. <br>

## Load JobList

Clears the present jobs table.<br>
Asks for a new start date and time.<br>
Loads a joblist file from the subdirectory `joblists`. <br>
